    f.write(r.text)

lines = r.text.strip().split('\n')
print(f'Total lines: {len(lines)}')

header = lines[1].split('\t')
print(f'Header columns ({len(header)}):')
for i, h in enumerate(header):
    print(f'  {i}: {h}')

# Check Zygosity values
zyg_idx = header.index('Zygosity')
gene_idx = header.index('Gene Names')

zyg_vals = set()
genes = set()
for line in lines[2:]:
    fields = line.split('\t')
    if len(fields) > zyg_idx:
        zyg_vals.add(fields[zyg_idx])
    if len(fields) > gene_idx:
        genes.add(fields[gene_idx])

print(f'\\nZygosity values: {zyg_vals}')
print(f'Number of unique genes: {len(genes)}')

# Count non-reference variants by gene
from collections import Counter
gene_counts = Counter()
ref_count = 0
nonref_count = 0
for line in lines[2:]:
    fields = line.split('\t')
    if len(fields) > max(zyg_idx, gene_idx):
        zyg = fields[zyg_idx]
        gene = fields[gene_idx]
